test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

From cradle to grave

options.text: Buying something very cheap or very expensive
During the whole span of one’s life
Giving directions and telling someone to follow

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"From cradle to grave"** means during the entire span of one's life, from birth to death. (जन्म से मृत्यु तक) • **Example: **The healthcare system aims to provide services from cradle to grave. • **"During the whole span of one’s life" **refers to the complete duration of a person's existence, from beginning to end. (जीवन की पूरी अवधि) • **Example: **He dedicated himself to his work from cradle to grave. • Hence, we can infer that the meaning of **'From cradle to grave' **is **'During the whole span of one’s life'**. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Buying something very cheap or very expensive** (बहुत सस्ता या बहुत महंगा खरीदना): Refers to purchasing items either at a very low price or a very high price. • **Example:** He bought the car either very cheap or very expensive, but I'm not sure which. • **Giving directions and telling someone to follow** (निर्देश देना और किसी को पालन करने के लिए कहना): Refers to instructing someone on what to do and expecting them to comply. • **Example: **The manager was always giving directions and telling everyone to follow. • **To achieve something you needed** (कुछ हासिल करना जो आपको चाहिए): Refers to successfully obtaining something that was required or desired. • **Example:** She worked hard to achieve the promotion she needed. 3de:Tab2, The correct answer is: **Option 4.**
